_about: The source turbo pump's load guard (src/core/turbo_guard.py; docs/how-it-works/turbo-guard.md). It warns when the turbo's current stays high at full speed - as when the valve to its backing pump was closed on 26 October 2026 - or it runs too hot, and, if its current doesn't fall back, shuts the source down while it still has hours in hand. The turbo itself is never stopped. Times in seconds.
_current: Overloaded: the current above overload_current_a at full speed. normal_current_a is the current at full speed with the backing line open (26 October 2026, overnight: 0.7-0.8 A): the shutdown waits while the current is falling back towards it.
_temperatures: Too hot, whatever the room: the bearing above bearing_limit_c or the converter above converter_limit_c (normally 43 and 28 degC). A warning only.
_stages: WARNING after warn_after_s overloaded without a break, or hot_after_s too hot (or with the pump's own warning); CRITICAL critical_after_s after the warning; the source shut down trip_after_s after the warning (or pump_warning_trip_s after the pump's own warning, if sooner) unless the current's excess over normal has fallen by falling_fraction from its peak in the last falling_window_s. The alarms clear after clear_after_s back to normal.
_judging: The current only at full speed (at_speed_pct of its maximum) for settle_s - a run-up draws 8 A for about 6 minutes; readings smoothed over smooth_s (a gas burst lasts seconds).
